summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the technical implementation of tracking user movement within a space. Initially, [me] proposed adding entry and exit vectors (delta x/y) to the database table. The core debate centered on whether velocity or just direction was necessary for accurate tracking.

It was determined that sending full vectors (entry and exit deltas) is acceptable, as this provides more robust data than relying solely on point matching. [p1] clarified that IDs might change if movement speed or direction changes significantly, potentially causing session breaks even when the user continues moving within a confined area.

Ultimately, they agreed to proceed with sending the full vectors (entry and exit deltas) for tracking purposes.
decisions: The system will track movement using entry and exit delta vectors (Float64 for x and y).
Full vectors are preferred over just direction/angle due to robustness issues in ID matching.
action_items: Someone needs to finalize the name/schema for the new vector data structure.
